query_metrics.csv.availability: Header only in LIGHT/DETAIL: current executable does not export per-query measurements.
query_metrics.csv.extension_policy: Append optional versioned columns when real D1/D4/D6 measurements become available.

system_metrics.csv.format: Long form numeric metrics; one row per metric, per sample, per CPU/PID/device.
system_metrics.csv.time: Native sysstat local time (iostat includes date/offset); manifest identifies run start/end. No invented UTC conversion.
system_metrics.csv.units: percent, ms, KiB, KiB/s, 1/s, or empty when unknown; raw telemetry logs preserved.

run_index.csv.policy: One row per finalized run, including failed runs. Derived from manifest/summary under flock and atomic replacement. Existing incompatible headers are preserved and reported.
